# Sovereign and Social-Impact Finance Agent

> Separates sovereign repayment, contractual recourse, net fiscal economics, financing additionality, social outcomes and the existence of an investable instrument. Institutional-quality buy-side research, designed to support tradable investment decisions through a traceable, auditable workflow.

Prepared software package v0.1.0, by HHFinAi. No embedded model, live feed, automatic trade execution or independent certification. Optional navigation only; not a guaranteed indexing mechanism.
